profit_quality.assessment: Reported 2025 parent net profit was RMB301.002m and operating cash flow was RMB581.529m, so cash conversion is strong in the current year. However, 2023-2025 parent profit was volatile at RMB-196.265m, RMB92.064m and RMB301.002m, and the business still has education prepayment, school-development-fund and PRC/VIE distribution constraints. The main numerator uses a pre-haircut distributable cash profit of RMB260.0m and applies a 0.55 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Start from a normalized 2025 owner-profit reference: RMB301.002m - bank interest income RMB18.207m - impairment reversal RMB5.061m + FVTPL loss RMB26.025m = about RMB303.759m.

Translate accounting profit into pre-haircut distributable cash profit of RMB260.0m after allowing for maintenance capex above depreciation/amortisation and the fact that part of operating cash flow comes from education prepayments.

Use 0.55 profit haircut because 2025 is only one strong year after 2023-2024 impairment drag, entertainment/e-commerce remains loss-making, and PRC/VIE/school structures reduce cash distribution certainty.
Do not use the rough-screen net profit directly as sustainable cash profit.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB373.895m in 2023, RMB367.427m in 2024 and RMB581.529m in 2025; 2025 purchases of property and equipment were RMB119.827m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Strong reported cash conversion is offset by volatile reported profit, prior impairment history, education prepayment dynamics and uncertainty over cash distribution from PRC/VIE operating entities.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Cash conversion is good on reported OCF/owner-profit, but tuition prepayments and contract-liability growth mean not all operating cash is freely distributable.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed. The analysis uses RMB120m as a conservative anchor, close to 2025 property and equipment purchases and above 2024 purchases, while recognizing some capex may be growth or campus-related.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working capital released cash through lower receivables and higher contract liabilities. The main profit haircut rather than a separate positive working-capital adjustment handles this volatility.
